build.profile: a straight 22 mm pencil tube with two fine seam rings and a rounded grille cap. No product photo was opened for this device, so the silhouette is a plausible lathe profile drawn from the published length and widest diameter, NOT measured from a photo or drawing: the size is exact, the shape between the stations is an estimate (confidence guess).

Colours: a typical finish for this kind of microphone, lifted for the creation lighting, not sampled from a photo unless a datasheet says the colour. A satin-nickel tube with seam rings and a fine mesh over the capsule head. out-xlr: on the base (bottom) face at its centre; no drawing gives it, so the confidence is guess.
